messages.author: Sanna Sähkö
messages.text: Timo, I'm on work order WO-051. High temperature alarm on the unit, it cleared on its own and then came back about an hour later.

messages.author: Timo Tuuletin
messages.text: Is the cabinet door closed when it comes back? And when was the filter changed?

messages.author: Sanna Sähkö
messages.text: Door's closed. No sticker on the filter, it looks pretty grey.

messages.author: Timo Tuuletin
messages.text: Then I'd change the filter before anything else. A clogged filter is the usual reason for a temperature alarm that comes and goes like that. If it still comes back with a clean filter, check that the fans actually ramp up when the alarm is on. I wouldn't touch the temperature thresholds.

messages.author: Sanna Sähkö
messages.text: Got a filter in the van. Doing it now.
